mandatoryCriteria: Column reordering: POST /api/v1/boards/:boardId/columns/reorder takes complete array of columnIds and updates position column values sequentially
Complete column set validation: Rejects reorder request if columnIds array does not match the exact set of active columns on the board with 400 or 422
Optimistic board versioning: Reorder verifies expectedBoardVersion against board structure_version; increments structure_version on success
